chapter: After Basie: own bands and composing
title: Opening the November 22 session
summary: Brower introduces the third session, with engineer Jean-Marc Shimonga, and asks about leaving Basie.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: My name is Bill Brower. I am interviewing Frank Foster for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program. The date is November 22, 1998, and serving as engineer for this session is Jean-Marc Shimonga. Maybe at this point a general comment about what your desires and motivations and plans were, what your objectives were, at the point you decided to leave the Basie band. What you saw for yourself. Then you could flow into how you have realized some of the things that you wanted to do at the point you decided that it was time to leave the Basie band.
